<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 141.115 Da, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈140.108 Da. The formula that best matches this mass with only C, H, O atoms is C₈H₁₂O₂ (exact mass 140.0837 Da), which is the closest reasonable composition.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H12O2</final_answer>
